newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 22.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government says student died one day after jumping from university residence first floor window after security forces broke up unauthorised meeting and students panicked

- Ivory Coast's privatisation committee to hold "open days" on January 29, 30 and 31 to explain progress so far; staff and management of privatised companies and international and national experts to take part.

- Ivory Coast's main port, in the the commercial capital Abidjan, is to refurbish a fruit terminal and buy two new container handling gantries, its managing director Jean-Michel Moulod says; tenders have been invited for the total eight billion CFA projects.

- Communication minister Danielle Boni-Claverie says press support and development fund proposed by the government is not an attempt to muzzle or influence the media but to help strengthen Ivory Coast's young democracy.
- University student dies after being beaten by police at university residence hall
- Security Minister Marcel Dibonan Kone says leader of banned student union FESCI, Guillaume Soro, faces arrest

- FESCI leader Guillaume Soro says student died after police beat him and threw him from first floor window of student residence; says FESCI maintains call for 72-hour university strike from today Wednesday and that the struggle will take on more radical tone
